UICorner.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
UICorner.Text = "Get Key"
UICorner.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 247, 250)
UICorner.TextSize = 15
UICorner.AutoButtonColor = true
UICorner.Parent = parent2
local UICorner2 = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICorner2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
UICorner2.Parent = UICorner
UICorner2 = Instance.new("TextButton")
UICorner2.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 45)
UICorner2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 266)
UICorner2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 42, 51)
UICorner2.BorderSizePixel = 0
UICorner2.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
UICorner2.Text = "Join Discord"
UICorner2.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 247, 250)
UICorner2.TextSize = 15
UICorner2.AutoButtonColor = true
UICorner2.Parent = parent2
local UICorner3 = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICorner3.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
UICorner3.Parent = UICorner2
UICorner3 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
UICorner3.BackgroundTransparency = 1
UICorner3.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 28)
UICorner3.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 319)
UICorner3.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
UICorner3.Text = ""
UICorner3.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 210, 255)
UICorner3.TextSize = 13
UICorner3.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
UICorner3.Parent = parent2
parent2 = function(p5, p6)
	UICorner3.Text = p5
	UICorner3.TextColor3 = p6 or Color3.fromRGB(150, 210, 255)

	local now = os.clock()

	UICorner3:SetAttribute("StatusId", now)
	now = function()
		local Parent = UICorner3.Parent

		if Parent then
			Parent = UICorner3:GetAttribute("StatusId") == now
		end

		if not Parent then
			return
		end

		UICorner3.Text = ""
	end
	task.delay(0.9, now)
end
pcall(function()
	parent.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
end)
local LocalPlayer = not parent.Parent and game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
if LocalPlayer then
	parent.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end
local v45
parent = function()
	local loadstring_ = loadstring or load

	if typeof(loadstring_) ~= "function" then
		UICorner3.Text = "Executor not supported (no loadstring)."
		UICorner3.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 110)

		return
	end

	UICorner3.Text = "Loading ReefHub..."

	local result

	loadstring_, result = pcall(loadstring_, v45)

	if not loadstring_ or typeof(result) ~= "function" then
		UICorner3.Text = "Compile Error: " .. tostring(result)
		UICorner3.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 110)

		return
	end

	loadstring_ = function()
		parent:Destroy()
	end
	pcall(loadstring_)
	loadstring_, result = pcall(result)

	if loadstring_ then
		return
	end

	warn("[ReefHub] Runtime Error: " .. tostring(result))
	UICorner3.Text = "Runtime Error: " .. tostring(result)
	UICorner3.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 110)
end
v45 = [[-- ReefHub | Peel THE Potato
-- PlaceId: 116701845804918

local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunSvc  = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS     = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local VIM     = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local VU      = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
local LP      = Players.LocalPlayer

local S = {
    Full = false, Collect = false, Peel = false, AutoStart = true,
    Place = false, Buttons = false, Sell = false, Crank = false,
    AntiAFK = true, Fast = false,
}
local CFG = {
    ClicksPerSec = 25,
    CollectPerSec = 15,
    Speed = 28,
    CollectTPDist = 18,
    TurnStrength = 350,
}
local peels = 0
local phase = "idle"

local function myRoot()
    local pf = workspace:FindFirstChild("Players")
    local c = pf and pf:FindFirstChild(LP.Name)
    return (c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
        or (LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
end

local function hum()
    local pf = workspace:FindFirstChild("Players")
    local c = pf and pf:FindFirstChild(LP.Name)
    return (c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
        or (LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
end

local function notify(t, msg)
    pcall(function()
        Rayfield:Notify({ Title = t, Content = msg, Duration = 3 })
    end)
end

-- ── Clicks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local BAD_BTN = {
    autopeel = true, peelall = true, leave = true, cancel = true, buy = true, purchase = true,
}

local function hitBadButton(sx, sy)
    local pg = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if not pg then return false end
    for _, g in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
        if (g:IsA("TextButton") or g:IsA("ImageButton")) and g.Visible then
            local name = string.lower(g.Name or "")
            local text = string.lower(g:IsA("TextButton") and (g.Text or "") or "")
            local bad = BAD_BTN[name]
                or name:find("autopeel") or name:find("peelall")
                or text:find("auto peel") or text:find("peel all")
                or text:find("leave") or text:find("buy")
            if bad and g.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 then
                local p, s = g.AbsolutePosition, g.AbsoluteSize
                if sx >= p.X and sx <= p.X + s.X and sy >= p.Y and sy <= p.Y + s.Y then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function safeClick(x, y)
    if hitBadButton(x, y) then return end
    pcall(function()
        VIM:SendMouseMoveEvent(x, y, game)
        VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, true,  game, 0)
        VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, false, game, 0)
    end)
end

local function releaseMouse()
    pcall(function()
        local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(400, 300)
        VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2, 0, false, game, 0)
    end)
end

local function clickWorld(pos)
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return false end
    local sp, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
    if not onScreen or sp.Z <= 0 then return false end
    if hitBadButton(sp.X, sp.Y) then return false end
    safeClick(sp.X, sp.Y)
    return true
end

local function clickCenter()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
    safeClick(vp.X / 2, vp.Y * 0.4)
end

local function aim(pos)
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam and pos then
        pcall(function() cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(cam.CFrame.Position, pos) end)
    end
end

local function dragTurn(cx, cy, amount)
    amount = amount or CFG.TurnStrength
    pcall(function()
        VIM:SendMouseMoveEvent(cx, cy, game)
        VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(cx, cy, 0, true, game, 0)
        for i = 1, 12 do
            local x = cx + (amount * i / 12)
            local y = cy + math.sin(i * 0.4) * 14
            VIM:SendMouseMoveEvent(x, y, game)
            task.wait(0.01)
        end
        VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(cx + amount, cy, 0, false, game, 0)
    end)
end

local pauseUntil = 0
local function overMenu()
    return os.clock() < pauseUntil
end
UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(_, gpe)
    if gpe then pauseUntil = os.clock() + 1.0 end
end)

-- ── Game helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function allPeelParts()
    local list = {}
    for _, mg in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if mg.Name == "UnpeeledPotatoForMinigame" or (mg:IsA("Model") and mg:FindFirstChild("Peel")) then
            for _, d in ipairs(mg:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name == "Peel" then
                    table.insert(list, d)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if #list == 0 then
        for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name == "Peel" and d.Parent and d.Parent:IsA("Model") then
                table.insert(list, d)
            end
        end
    end
    return list
end

local function nearestLivePotato()
    local pileFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("PotatoPile")
    local r = myRoot()
    if not pileFolder or not r then return nil end
    local best, bd = nil, math.huge
    for _, c in ipairs(pileFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("BasePart") and (c.LocalTransparencyModifier or 0) < 0.9 then
            local d = (c.Position - r.Position).Magnitude
            if d < bd then best, bd = c, d end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function ensureNearPotato(pot, dist)
    local r = myRoot()
    if not r or not pot then return end
    if (r.Position - pot.Position).Magnitude > (dist or CFG.CollectTPDist) then
        r.CFrame = CFrame.new(pot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 5))
    end
end

local function tpToPart(part)
    local r = myRoot()
    if not r or not part or not part.Parent then return false end
    local pos = part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Position
        or (part:IsA("Attachment") and part.WorldPosition)
        or (part.Parent and part.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and part.Parent.Position)
    if not pos then return false end
    r.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 4))
    return true
end

local function firePrompt(p)
    if not p or not p.Parent or typeof(fireproximityprompt) ~= "function" then return false end
    local hold, los, maxd = p.HoldDuration, p.RequiresLineOfSight, p.MaxActivationDistance
    pcall(function()
        p.HoldDuration = 0
        p.RequiresLineOfSight = false
        p.MaxActivationDistance = 1000
    end)
    local ok = pcall(fireproximityprompt, p)
    pcall(function()
        p.HoldDuration = hold
        p.RequiresLineOfSight = los
        p.MaxActivationDistance = maxd
    end)
    return ok
end

local function nearestPromptByAction(word)
    word = string.lower(word)
    local r = myRoot()
    local best, bd = nil, math.huge
    for _, p in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and p.Enabled
            and string.find(string.lower(p.ActionText or ""), word, 1, true) then
            local a = p.Parent
            local pos = a and (a:IsA("BasePart") and a.Position
                or a:IsA("Attachment") and a.WorldPosition)
            local d = (r and pos) and (r.Position - pos).Magnitude or 0
            if d < bd then best, bd = p, d end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function pressButton(name)
    local pg = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if not pg then return false end
    local b
    for _, g in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
        if (g:IsA("ImageButton") or g:IsA("TextButton")) and g.Name == name then
            b = g
            break
        end
    end
    if not b then return false end
    if typeof(getconnections) == "function" then
        pcall(function()
            for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(b.MouseButton1Click)) do
                if c.Function then c.Function() elseif c.Fire then c:Fire() end
            end
            for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(b.Activated)) do
                if c.Function then c.Function() elseif c.Fire then c:Fire() end
            end
        end)
        return true
    end
    if typeof(firesignal) == "function" then
        pcall(firesignal, b.MouseButton1Click)
        pcall(firesignal, b.Activated)
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function basketCount()
    local pg = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if not pg then return 0, 10 end
    for _, g in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
        if g:IsA("TextLabel") and g.Visible then
            local cur, mx = string.match(g.Text, "^%s*(%d+)%s*/%s*(%d+)%s*$")
            if cur and mx then
                local c, m = tonumber(cur), tonumber(mx)
                if m >= 5 and m <= 500 then return c, m end
            end
        end
    end
    return 0, 10
end

local function setPhase(p) phase = p end

local function doPeelClick()
    local parts = allPeelParts()
    if #parts == 0 then return nil end
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local best = parts[1]
    local cx, cy = 400, 300
    if cam then
        local bd = math.huge
        local sum = Vector3.zero
        for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
            sum += part.Position
            local sp, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
            if on and sp.Z > 0 then
                local c = cam.ViewportSize / 2
                local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - Vector2.new(c.X, c.Y)).Magnitude
                if d < bd then best, bd = part, d end
            end
        end
        local center = sum / #parts
        local sp = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(center)
        if sp.Z > 0 then cx, cy = sp.X, sp.Y end
    end
    return best, cx, cy
end

-- ── Full cycle ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function fullCycle()
    setPhase("collecting")
    local first = nearestLivePotato()
    if first then ensureNearPotato(first, 12) end
    local hardStop = os.clock() + 30
    while S.Full and os.clock() < hardStop do
        local cur, mx = basketCount()
        if cur >= mx and mx > 0 then break end
        if not overMenu() then
            local pot = nearestLivePotato()
            if pot then
                ensureNearPotato(pot, CFG.CollectTPDist)
                aim(pot.Position)
                if not clickWorld(pot.Position) then clickCenter() end
            end
        end
        setPhase("collecting " .. cur .. "/" .. mx)
        task.wait(1 / CFG.CollectPerSec)
    end
    if not S.Full then return end

    setPhase("placing")
    local place = nearestPromptByAction("place")
    if place then
        tpToPart(place.Parent)
        task.wait(0.4)
        firePrompt(place)
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
    if not S.Full then return end

    setPhase("peeling")
    local pp = nearestPromptByAction("peel")
    if pp then
        tpToPart(pp.Parent)
        task.wait(0.4)
        firePrompt(pp)
        task.wait(0.5)
    end

    local emptyFor, turnEvery = 0, 0
    while S.Full and emptyFor < 3.5 do
        local best, cx, cy = doPeelClick()
        if best then
            emptyFor = 0
            if not overMenu() then
                turnEvery += 1
                if turnEvery >= 3 then
                    turnEvery = 0
                    dragTurn(cx, cy, CFG.TurnStrength)
                    task.wait(0.04)
                    dragTurn(cx, cy, -math.floor(CFG.TurnStrength * 0.75))
                    task.wait(0.04)
                end
                aim(best.Position)
                if not clickWorld(best.Position) then safeClick(cx, cy) end
                peels += 1
            end
            task.wait(1 / CFG.ClicksPerSec)
        else
            emptyFor = emptyFor + 0.15
            local p2 = nearestPromptByAction("peel")
            if p2 then firePrompt(p2) end
            task.wait(0.15)
        end
    end
    if not S.Full then return end

    setPhase("selling")
    local sell = nearestPromptByAction("sell")
    if sell then
        tpToPart(sell.Parent)
        task.wait(0.4)
        firePrompt(sell)
        task.wait(0.6)
    end
    setPhase("idle")
end

-- ── Start Farm ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function startFarm()
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            if S.Full then
                local ok, e = pcall(fullCycle)
                if not ok then setPhase("err: " .. tostring(e)) task.wait(1) end
            else
                task.wait(0.2)
            end
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        local turnEvery = 0
        while true do
            if S.Peel and not overMenu() then
                local best, cx, cy = doPeelClick()
                if best then
                    turnEvery += 1
                    if turnEvery >= 3 then
                        turnEvery = 0
                        dragTurn(cx, cy, CFG.TurnStrength)
                        task.wait(0.04)
                        dragTurn(cx, cy, -math.floor(CFG.TurnStrength * 0.75))
                        task.wait(0.04)
                    end
                    aim(best.Position)
                    if not clickWorld(best.Position) then safeClick(cx, cy) end
                    peels += 1
                    task.wait(1 / CFG.ClicksPerSec)
                else
                    if S.AutoStart then
                        local p = nearestPromptByAction("peel")
                        if p then firePrompt(p) end
                    end
                    task.wait(0.4)
                end
            else
                task.wait(0.12)
            end
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            if S.Collect and not overMenu() then
                local pot = nearestLivePotato()
                if pot then
                    ensureNearPotato(pot, CFG.CollectTPDist)
                    aim(pot.Position)
                    if not clickWorld(pot.Position) then clickCenter() end
                end
                task.wait(1 / CFG.CollectPerSec)
            else
                task.wait(0.12)
            end
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            task.wait(0.55)
            if S.Buttons then
                pressButton("PeelAll")
                pressButton("AutoPeel")
            end
            if S.Place then
                local p = nearestPromptByAction("place")
                if p then tpToPart(p.Parent) task.wait(0.15) firePrompt(p) end
            end
            if S.Sell then
                local p = nearestPromptByAction("sell")
                if p then firePrompt(p) end
            end
            if S.Crank then
                local p = nearestPromptByAction("crank")
                if p then firePrompt(p) end
            end
        end
    end)

    RunSvc.Stepped:Connect(function()
        if S.Fast then
            local h = hum()
            if h and h.WalkSpeed < CFG.Speed then h.WalkSpeed = CFG.Speed end
        end
    end)

    local function stopAll()
        for k in pairs(S) do S[k] = false end
        S.AntiAFK = true
        releaseMouse()
        phase = "stopped"
        notify("STOPPED", "all features off")
    end

    UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(io, gpe)
        if gpe then return end
        if io.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.K or io.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
            stopAll()
        end
    end)

    LP.Idled:Connect(function()
        if S.AntiAFK then
            pcall(function()
                VU:Button2Down(Vector2.new(0, 0), workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)
                task.wait(1)
                VU:Button2Up(Vector2.new(0, 0), workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)
            end)
        end
    end)

    local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
        Name = "ReefHub | Peel THE Potato",
        LoadingTitle = "ReefHub",
        LoadingSubtitle = "Peel THE Potato",
        Theme = "AmberGlow",
        ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
        KeySystem = false,
    })

    local Main = Window:CreateTab("Auto Farm", 4483362458)

    Main:CreateToggle({
        Name = "FULL AUTO (collect → place → peel → sell)",
        CurrentValue = false,
        Flag = "full",
        Callback = function(v)
            S.Full = v
            if not v then releaseMouse() setPhase("idle") end
        end,
    })

    Main:CreateLabel("— individual stages —")

    Main:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Auto Collect (pile)",
        CurrentValue = false,
        Flag = "collect",
        Callback = function(v) S.Collect = v if not v then releaseMouse() end end,
    })

    Main:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Auto Peel (strong turn + clicks)",
        CurrentValue = false,
        Flag = "peel",
        Callback = function(v) S.Peel = v peels = 0 if not v then releaseMouse() end end,
    })

    Main:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Auto Start PEEL prompt",
        CurrentValue = true,
        Flag = "autostart",
        Callback = function(v) S.AutoStart = v end,
    })

    Main:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Auto Place",
        CurrentValue = false,
        Flag = "place",
        Callback = function(v) S.Place = v end,
    })

    Main:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Press PeelAll / AutoPeel (gamepass)",
        CurrentValue = false,
        Flag = "buttons",
        Callback = function(v) S.Buttons = v end,
    })

    Main:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Auto Sell",
        CurrentValue = false,
        Flag = "sell",
        Callback = function(v) S.Sell = v end,
    })

    Main:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Auto Crank",
        CurrentValue = false,
        Flag = "crank",
        Callback = function(v) S.Crank = v end,
    })

    Main:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Peel clicks/sec",
        Range = { 5, 90 }, Increment = 1, Suffix = "/s",
        CurrentValue = 25, Flag = "peelspeed",
        Callback = function(v) CFG.ClicksPerSec = v end,
    })

    Main:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Collect clicks/sec",
        Range = { 5, 60 }, Increment = 1, Suffix = "/s",
        CurrentValue = 15, Flag = "collectspeed",
        Callback = function(v) CFG.CollectPerSec = v end,
    })

    Main:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Collect TP distance",
        Range = { 8, 40 }, Increment = 1, Suffix = " studs",
        CurrentValue = 18, Flag = "tpdist",
        Callback = function(v) CFG.CollectTPDist = v end,
    })

    Main:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Turn strength (potato spin)",
        Range = { 80, 280 }, Increment = 10, Suffix = " px",
        CurrentValue = 180, Flag = "turn",
        Callback = function(v) CFG.TurnStrength = v end,
    })

    local phaseLabel = Main:CreateLabel("phase: idle")

    local Misc = Window:CreateTab("Misc", 4483362458)

    Misc:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Fast Walk", CurrentValue = false, Flag = "fast",
        Callback = function(v) S.Fast = v end,
    })

    Misc:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Anti-AFK", CurrentValue = true, Flag = "antiafk",
        Callback = function(v) S.AntiAFK = v end,
    })

    Misc:CreateButton({
        Name = "Test: find peels",
        Callback = function()
            local n = #allPeelParts()
            notify("Peels", n > 0 and ("found " .. n) or "none — start peel at table")
        end,
    })

    Misc:CreateButton({
        Name = "Release mouse",
        Callback = function() releaseMouse() notify("Mouse", "released") end,
    })

    Misc:CreateButton({
        Name = "STOP ALL (or press K)",
        Callback = function() stopAll() end,
    })

    Misc:CreateButton({
        Name = "Copy Discord Invite",
        Callback = function()
            if setclipboard then setclipboard("https://discord.gg/BeXJBSE9Fn") end
            notify("Discord", "Invite copied to clipboard")
        end,
    })

    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            task.wait(0.4)
            pcall(function()
                phaseLabel:Set("phase: " .. phase .. "  |  peels: " .. peels)
            end)
        end
    end)

    notify("ReefHub", "Peel THE Potato unlocked")
    print("ReefHub | Peel THE Potato ready")
end

-- Start the script immediately since the ReefHub Key System handles authentication
startFarm()
]]
parent3:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
	UICorner.Text = parent3.Text == "" and "Get Key" or false or "Check Key"
end)
UICorner2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if v2("https://discord.gg/BeXJBSE9Fn") then
		parent2("Discord copied to clipboard.")

		return
	else
		UICorner3.Text = "https://discord.gg/BeXJBSE9Fn"
		UICorner3.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 110)

		return
	end
end)
UICorner.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if parent3.Text == "" then
		if v2("https://work.ink/2Z3w/keydestination") then
			parent2("Key copied to clipboard.")

			return
		else
			UICorner3.Text = "https://work.ink/2Z3w/keydestination"
			UICorner3.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 110)

			return
		end

		return
	else
		local v48 = string.upper(parent3.Text:gsub("%s+", ""))

		parent3.Text = v48

		if v21(v48) then
			parent()

			return
		else
			UICorner3.Text = "That key is invalid."
			UICorner3.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120)

			return
		end

		return
	end
end)
